title: Book Two · Chapter 68: Leo's Free Afternoon
story:
Two days later, Leo comes to the green door at the agreed time. His bag looks full. Ronan looks behind him for an adult.

“Do you have to go somewhere?”

“Later. Not now.”

Leo takes out a book and puts it on the table. A small paper stands between the pages.

“I must finish this before the next reading morning.”

Ronan's face falls. “I thought we could play.”

“We can. I finished it before lunch.”

“Then why did you bring it?”

“I want to show you the picture.”

The page shows a boy with a large hat. A bird stands on the top. Ronan reads the first few lines. The boy does not know about the bird. Everyone else can see it.

“Does he feed it?”

“Not at first.”

They read the ending together. The bird flies away with a piece of bread from the boy's hand. Ronan laughs at the picture of his empty hand.

Leo closes his bag. “Now the ball.”

They go into the yard. Ronan puts two old shoes near the wall for a goal. Mum asks them to keep the gate clear. They move the shoes farther apart, away from the path.

Leo kicks first. The ball passes outside one shoe. Ronan scores on his second try. He lifts his arms. Then Leo moves one shoe closer to the other. Ronan sees him.

“Your goal is smaller now.”

“It was too big.”

“After my turn?”

Leo looks at the two shoes. He moves it back. Together, they choose a place for the next round.

After three rounds, both boys are hot. Mum gives them water at the door. Leo sits on the step and wipes his forehead.

“Do you like all your activities?” Ronan asks.

“Some. I like the reading stories. I do not like the extra page when I am tired.”

“Can you skip it?”

“I can tell my parents. I cannot just hide it.”

Ronan looks at the full bag inside. The room is quiet. Leo finished his work early. That gave him time to play. His parents agreed to keep this afternoon free too.

They go back for one last round. Leo scores twice. Ronan scores once and wants another try. Leo points toward the clock inside the door.

“I have to leave.”

Ronan puts the ball under his arm. He wants five more minutes. But he walks Leo to the gate. Then he picks up the shoes. Mum is waiting for one of them so she can go out.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

free＝空闲的；choose＝选择；skip＝跳过。

## 理解问题

1. Leo为什么提前完成练习？
2. 两个朋友怎样度过约好的下午？

## 读句子

**Leo / closes / his bag.** Leo／合上／他的书包。
